payload.reason: The re-ranking approach described in the paper is a transductive learning technique because it utilizes information from the deployed QA system and its top-10 candidates to improve answer selection without retraining the entire model.

claims.text: The re-ranking approach learns a similarity function using features from the query and the initial system confidence, indicating it operates on the outputs of a pre-trained model.
The method improves the performance of already deployed QA systems by re-ranking the top-10 candidates based on user feedback, characteristic of transductive learning.
